tei:div.tei:p: zhi khro'i bdag bskyed mdor bsdus dgongs pa rang grol bzhugs so// rang byung zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhi khro'i bdag bskyed mdor bsdus gsal gdab ni/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun bcas sngon song rjes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/= skye med chos dbyings zhing khams su// 'gag med gsal dag thig le'i dbus// rin chen khri rkang pad zla'i steng*// rang sems ma bcos stong pa'i mdangs// rang rig rdo rje sems dpar shar// dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// snang stong rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// rigs lngas dbu brgyan longs sku'i chas// rin chen rgyan rdzogs phyed skyil bzhugs// thugs kar zla steng hūm̐ yig la// yig brgyas bskor las 'od 'phros pas// rgyal ba kun mchod 'gro rnams kyi// sgrib sbyangs rdor sems sku ru gyur// de nas rang nyid rdor sems kyi// tsit+ta rin chen gzhal yas khang*// ye shes 'od lnga'i thig ler gsal// seng ge glang chen rta mchog dang*// rma bya shang shang nyi zla'i steng*// kun bzang rigs lnga yab yum dang*// sems dpa' yab yum bcu drug dang*// sgo bzhir sgo ba yab yum brgyad// gnas drug sprul sku thub pa drug /rang rang rgyan dang cha lugs ldan// snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa// snang stong lhun grub 'od kyi sku// gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brjid 'bar// de yi rang mdangs ma 'gags rtsal// dung khang 'ja' 'od me dpung klong/ khrag 'thung yab yum bcu gnyis dang*// ke'u rī brgyad dang sing ha brgyad// sgo ma bzhi dang dbang phyug ma// nyi shu rtsa brgyad khrag 'thung lha/ khro gtum gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan// dpal chen dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs// gsal stong 'od kyi sku ru bzhugs// mgrin pa longs spyod 'khor lo ru// 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil du// rig 'dzin yab yum bcu po la// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor// gsal 'tsher mdangs dang ldan par bzhugs// gzhan yang rang lus rtsa khams su// rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo grangs med bcas// til gyi gong bu phyes pa bzhin// ye nas lhun grub chen por bzhugs// de ltar zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams// gdod nas rang dang lhan cig tu// dbyer med lhan cig skyes par bzhugs// de dag rang snang dag pa'i lha// yin par shes shing yin tshul du// ma bcos rang mdangs rang gsal gdab// oṃ āḥhūm̐:

bho dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ lha rnams thugs kar zla ba'i steng*// rang rang sa bon gsal ba la// zhi ba rnams ni bho dhis bskor/ khro bo rnams la ru lus bskor// rang rang zhal nas sngags sgra sgrog /'od zer yar 'phros rgyal ba mchod// thugs dam bskul zhing dngos grub bsdus// mar 'phros 'gro ba'i sdig sgrib sbyangs// thams cad zhi khro'i sku ru gyur// sngags sgra sgrog pas snang srid khengs// phyi snod dag pa lha yi zhing*// nang bcud lha dang lha mor gyur// sgra grags sngags kyi rang bzhin la// dran rtog chos nyid rol pa'i ngang*// ma bcos rtsol med rang lugs su// ma yengs rang gsal ngang du bzhag /zhi khro'i bdag bskyed mdor bsdus 'di// rdzogs chen don la blo phyogs pa'i// pad+ma ma tis bris pa 'di'i// dge bas kun bzang klong grol shog /bkra shis par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o/ dge'o/ dge'o// //
